'''Ovech''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Ovech had served under [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Broysc]] along with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Malavai Quinn]] and had a high opinion of him, until Broysc arranged Quinn's reassignment to [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. By the time of the [[Galactic War]] Quinn was serving the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]] and traveling aboard the [[Fury-class Imperial interceptor|''Fury''-class Imperial interceptor]], when he registered an emergency transmission from Ovech. By the time his call was answered Ovech had given up all hope and was glad to see a familiar face in Quinn. Ovech explained that Moff Broysc had sent him and the other officers to a supposedly secret warehouse on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], where they found an ambush waiting for them. As transmission broke, Quinn immediately launched a rescue operation, which was a huge success and resulted in saving the lives of Ovech and the majority of other officers.
